title: VideoJAM: Joint Appearance-Motion Representations for Enhanced Motion Generation in Video Models
summary: The core guidance justification confuses parameter gradients with sampling-state gradients and incorrectly makes removal of conditioning marginal depend on model-weight independence. Exact positive smooth Gaussian counterexample and identity establish failure of that reasoning.
limitations: VideoJAM implementation unavailable in staged sources
Full corrected joint sampler not verified

problems.title: Weight dependence does not obstruct conditional state-score algebra

claim.location: Section2 PDFp3; Section4.3 Eq8 PDFp5; AppendixA Eqs9-11 PDFp12
claim.paraphrase: Existing guidance cannot omit conditioning marginal when conditions depend on model weights; Eq8 uses parameter derivative as diffusion score.

assumptions: Realized conditions held fixed for conditional state derivative
Positive differentiable normalized joint probability density
For modified joint density, normalizing constant finite

check.type: analytic identity plus independent finite-difference validation
check.counterexample: C1=theta+N1, C2=C1+N2, X=C1+C2+N3 with independent standard normals; theta0.4,c1=1,c2=0.2,x2
check.hypotheses_verified: All conditional variances1; smooth strictly positive density; conditions correlated and marginal depends ontheta
check.correct_result: State derivative of conditioning marginal0; conditional and joint state derivatives both−0.8; joint and marginal parameter derivative0.6; conditional parameter derivative0
check.consequence: Parameter dependence is irrelevant to omission in fixed-condition state derivative.

counterevidence: Eq7 remains a valid density construction if normalizable.
Replacing gradient subscript alone does not fix repeated prose.
Joint-state differentiation differs from fixed-condition differentiation; coordinate dependence needs explicit treatment.
problems.impact: Invalid derivation/rationale directly underpins Inner-Guidance, a principal method component and explanation of ablation comparison. No empirical score loss required or asserted.

correction.statement: Use gradient with respect to z=(x,d): (1+w1+w2)s(z|y)−w1s(z)−w2(s_x(x|y),0_d).
correction.verified_scope: Density-level identity only; correct score-to-flow mapping derived; motion component of dropped branch unresolved

acceptance_check.truth_and_assumptions: Section 4.3 Equation (8) and Appendix A confuse a parameter derivative with a fixed-condition state derivative; weight dependence does not obstruct the latter.
acceptance_check.decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence: Bayes differentiation and the correlated Gaussian example give conditional state derivative -0.8, marginal state derivative 0 and marginal parameter derivative 0.6. Changing the printed gradient symbol alone does not repair the accompanying weight-independence argument.
acceptance_check.core_dependency_and_severity: Major: this invalid derivation justifies the core Inner-Guidance component. Joint regression, the tilted density and reported empirical gains are not refuted.
acceptance_check.correction_scope: The corrected joint score and affine score-to-velocity map are checked; padding the appearance score gives velocity (u_x,d/t), so a fully corrected implemented sampler remains unresolved.

repair_verification: State-score identity proved; sampler implementation unresolved
